text:
laura_prod: quick sync — I pushed the welcome spotlight tile prototype to figma. goal: make first-run feel lightweight but discoverable. main questions: 1) banner vs tile in the header lane? 2) sample project curation UI (single list vs grouped cards)? 3) keyboard/focus behavior for the add-sample flow. screenshot + flow in thread.

mike_design: saw it — nice baseline. my gut: tile in header lane is less interruptive, banner grabs attention but feels modal-y. tile can expand inline to a 2-line CTA. copy thought: 'Try a sample project' -> 'Explore starter project' (less salesy).

jasper_devex: agree with tile. also important: if we defer the heavy network call for sample metadata until the tile expands, we can keep initial load <200ms. we should expose a lightweight placeholder and lazy-load details.

olivia_pm: +1 on lazy-load. metrics we care about: first-sample-click pct, time-to-first-run, and new user retention after 7d. can we A/B test banner vs tile?

mike_design: A/B sounds good. also accessibility nit: when the tile expands, focus should shift to the first interactive control and return to the same place after close. keyboard order needs to be linear — no skipping. aria suggestion: use role="dialog" for the expanded panel and set aria-modal="false" since it isn't a blocker.

aria_access: quick a11y checklist: 1) contrast of the CTA (button bg vs bg) needs 4.5:1 for normal text; current orange on white is 3.8:1. 2) focus styles — current outline removed in design; please keep visible 3px or use visible ring. 3) screen reader copy: don't use just icons for the sample type cards — include hidden text like "Sample: Sentiment analysis".

laura_prod: noted — mike can you update the CTA color tokens and add focus ring in the component? jasper — can you gate the metadata fetch behind the expand event? olivia — I'll add the AB test flag to the rollout plan. aria — can you draft the SR copy?

mike_design: will update tokens. thinking of two CTA text variants for the test: 'Explore starter project' vs 'Create from sample' — which is clearer?

aria_access: 'Explore starter project' reads more discoverable; 'Create from sample' implies commitment and might scare some people. go with Explore. also proposed SR label for tile: "aria-label": "Welcome — explore starter projects".

jasper_devex: implemented lazy fetch in the prototype branch. sample card placeholders use shimmer, and expand fires /samples/meta fetch only once per session. also added a localStorage flag to avoid re-fetching if they collapse/expand repeatedly. code snippet: `if (!sessionStorage.getItem('samplesLoaded')) fetch('/api/samples/meta')`

olivia_pm: timeline: reach consensus today, design update by EOD, dev branch PR early next week, AB flag ready for QA by Wed. acceptance criteria: keyboard nav works, contrast fixed, and metric hooks wired.

laura_prod: small copy tweak: heading 'Welcome to Redwood' -> 'Welcome to Redwood Inference' to reduce ambiguity when customers see multiple Redwood products in docs screenshots.

mike_design: done. adjusted heading weight and updated responsive truncation — long org names now wrap to second line under 600px.

onboard-bot: reminder — please attach the accessibility checklist ticket (ENG-ONBOARD-112) and link the figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/welcome-spotlight.

aria_access: I'll open a short a11y QA ticket with checklist steps and sample screenreader keystrokes to verify (nvda/jaws + VoiceOver). will ping when ready. :white_check_mark:

laura_prod: thanks everyone — final ask: if you have any blockers for the AB variants or the focus behavior, drop them here by EOD. otherwise i'll merge design and hand off to devs tomorrow. :sparkles:
